singleVariable.A1AndA2: Existing J1 timing with no harness gate
singleVariable.B: Wait for the client-selection summary dashboard request to settle before dispatching the Forms click
singleVariable.gateApplied: B 3/3; all settled as request_failed before Forms dispatch

interpretation.observationResult: The controlled run did not reproduce the historical post-Forms summary re-entry in either baseline or the settlement-gated group.
interpretation.functionalResult: All nine samples completed the Forms and Nutrition actions successfully.
interpretation.speedResult: Second-action tails were captured per group, but this diagnostic run is not a performance acceptance run and no causal speed comparison is claimed.

blockers: The controlled A1-B-A2 run reproduced neither the historical post-Forms summary re-entry nor a Forms abort.
The candidate therefore has no current abort contrast and no three-matching valid abort records.
The historical abort traces still lack the new route-state fields.
explicitNonClaims: The settlement gate is a harness-only diagnostic control, not a product fix.
No auth, routing, request-coalescing, scheduling, or React-render remediation was accepted.
This evidence is outside the official nine-scenario baseline and does not change Plan 1 closure or Plan 2 eligibility.
No external provider, WhatsApp, billing, production worker, migration, deploy, or real health-data path was used.

closure.nextAction: Do not repeat this same settlement-gated A-B-A automatically. Preserve the result, keep the global diagnosis blocked, and choose a distinct trigger only if separately authorized.
